hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" && SIDEGRAPH_DIR=.sidegraph SIDEGRAPH_GRAPH=graphify-out/graph.json uvx --from git+https://github.com/SantyagoSeaman/sidegraph.git@main sidegraph-session-start || printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Sidegraph: the SessionStart hook could not start (uv/uvx, network or project path); run the hook command in a terminal to see the error"}'

f="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/sidegraph/launch-commit"; c=; [ -f "$f" ] && c=$(head -c 41 "$f" 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *[!0123456789abcdef]*) c= ;; esac; [ "${#c}" -eq 40 ] || c=; u=git+https://github.com/SantyagoSeaman/sidegraph.git@main; [ -n "$c" ] && [ "${u##*@}" = main ] && u=${u%@*}@$c; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" && SIDEGRAPH_DIR=.sidegraph SIDEGRAPH_GRAPH=graphify-out/graph.json uvx --from "$u" sidegraph-stop || printf '{}\n'
